notes.3: Gap outliers are measured against a reference system every study in the group measured, preferring a named baseline, per protocol or task and metric; groups without one are skipped. Disputed results and results under an evidence concern are left out. IDs hash rule, systems, anchor, metric and a stable outlier study key. See docs/reviews/2026-10-23-discrepancy-identity.md.
notes.2: Sources with one DOI, and files from one GitHub repository, are one study; a reversal of a strong consensus goes up a severity step. See docs/reviews/2026-10-22-discrepancy-severity.md.
